subject: Disable automatic invitation for added users and users lists

messages.author: 6a6bf286a7138e75
messages.subject: Disable automatic invitation for added users and users lists
parts:
Is it possible to add an option to disable automatic invitation for every user that is added to an app? Also it will be very practical to be able to add a list of users without having to add each one manually.
Thank you

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Disable automatic invitation for added users and users lists
